findings.description: The overflow short-circuit now calls math.log(self.multiplier, self.exp_base) separately. This raises ValueError when multiplier <= 0. The previous form, math.log(self.max / self.multiplier, ...), had the same failure for multiplier <= 0 (and a ZeroDivisionError for 0), so this is a change in the exception type rather than a new failure.
findings.rationale: Trigger: wait_exponential(multiplier=0, max=10) with a large attempt number. The short-circuit condition is evaluated first, and math.log(0) raises ValueError (math domain error) outside the try block, so the wait computation crashes. Before the change, max/0 raised ZeroDivisionError, so the call failed either way.
